title: make_channel(0) panics: capacity=0 not guarded
description: kith-events/src/lib.rs make_channel(capacity: usize) passes the caller-supplied value directly to tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(). tokio broadcast panics if capacity is 0. All current call sites pass 64, but the public API provides no guard. If a future caller passes 0 (e.g. from a config value), the daemon panics on first send. Fix: add assert!(capacity > 0, "broadcast channel capacity must be > 0") or clamp to max(capacity, 1) at the top of make_channel.
